content.raw_text: “你必须明白这一点！”邓布利多站了起来，在屋子里大步地走来走去，闪亮的袍子在身后呼呼飘动。哈利还从没见他这么激动过，“在企图杀你的时候，伏地魔就亲自选出了坐在我面前的这个卓越的人，并为他提供了工具！你能看到伏地魔的思想、野心，甚至能听懂他发令时那蛇说话般的语言，这都只能怪他自己。可是，哈利，尽管你能洞察伏地魔的世界——要知道，这是任何食死徒不惜用杀人来换取的能力，但你却从未接受黑魔法的诱惑，从未显露过丝毫想要追随伏地魔的欲望，一秒钟都没有！”

sentences.text: “你必须明白这一点！
sentences.translation: You must understand this!
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the necessity of understanding something, using the word '必须' (must) to convey a strong obligation.

sentences.text: ”邓布利多站了起来，在屋子里大步地走来走去，闪亮的袍子在身后呼呼飘动。
sentences.translation: Dumbledore stood up and paced around the room, his shiny robe fluttering behind him.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a reduplication structure '走来走去' which means pacing around. The use of adverbial particle '地' before '走来走去' is a common grammar structure in Chinese.

sentences.text: 哈利还从没见他这么激动过，“在企图杀你的时候，伏地魔就亲自选出了坐在我面前的这个卓越的人，并为他提供了工具！
sentences.translation: Harry has never seen him so excited before, 'When Voldemort attempted to kill you, he personally selected this outstanding person sitting in front of me and provided him with the tool!'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex grammar structures such as the use of '在...的时候' (when) and '就...并...' (not only... but also...). The vocabulary includes terms related to the Harry Potter series, such as 'Voldemort' and 'tool'.

sentences.text: 你能看到伏地魔的思想，野心，甚至能听懂他发令时那蛇说话般的语言，这都只能怪他自己。
sentences.translation: You can see Voldemort's thoughts, ambitions, and even understand his snake-like language when he gives orders, all of which can only be blamed on himself.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the ability to understand Voldemort's thoughts and language, emphasizing that it is his own fault.

sentences.text: 可是，哈利，尽管你能洞察伏地魔的世界——
sentences.translation: However, Harry, even though you can see into Voldemort's world—
sentences.explanation: The structure '尽管...，' means 'even though' in this context, indicating a contrast or concession.

sentences.text: 要知道，这是任何食死徒不惜用杀人来换取的能力，但你却从未接受黑魔法的诱惑，从未显露过丝毫想要追随伏地魔的欲望，一秒钟都没有！
sentences.translation: You know, this is the ability that any Death Eater would not hesitate to use killing to obtain, but you have never succumbed to the temptation of dark magic, never shown the slightest desire to follow Voldemort, not even for a second!
sentences.explanation: This sentence praises the listener for never succumbing to the temptation of dark magic and never showing any desire to follow Voldemort, not even for a second.

sentences.translation: Of course not!

sentences.text: ”哈利愤怒地说，“他杀了我的父母！
sentences.translation: Harry angrily said, "He killed my parents!"

content.raw_text: “简而言之，是你的爱保护了你！”邓布利多大声说，“惟有这种保护，才有可能抵御伏地魔那样的权力的诱惑！虽然经历了那么多诱惑，那么多痛苦，你依然心地纯洁，还像你十一岁时那样。当时你向那面能照出你内心愿望的镜子中望去，看到的只有怎样挫败伏地魔，而没有永生和财富。哈利，你知不知道，世上没有几个巫师能看到你在镜中看到的东西？伏地魔那时就该知道他要对付的是什么，可惜他没有！

sentences.text: “简而言之，是你的爱保护了你！
sentences.translation: In short, it is your love that protects you!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Possessive + Object + Verb, which may be different from English. The use of '了' at the end of the sentence indicates the completion of the action of protection.

sentences.text: ”邓布利多大声说，“惟有这种保护，才有可能抵御伏地魔那样的权力的诱惑！
sentences.translation: Dumbledore said loudly, 'Only with this kind of protection, is it possible to resist the temptation of power like Voldemort's!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the necessity of a specific kind of protection to resist the allure of power, especially the power wielded by Voldemort.

sentences.text: 虽然经历了那么多诱惑，那么多痛苦，你依然心地纯洁，还像你十一岁时那样。
sentences.translation: Although you have experienced so many temptations and so much pain, you still have a pure heart, just like when you were eleven years old.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the structure '虽然...，但是...' which means 'although...still...' to express contrast. It also compares the person's current state to when they were eleven years old.

sentences.text: 当时你向那面能照出你内心愿望的镜子中望去，看到的只有怎样挫败伏地魔而没有永生和财富。
sentences.translation: When you looked into the mirror that can reflect your inner desires, all you saw was how to defeat Voldemort, without eternal life and wealth.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes what the person saw when looking into a mirror that reflects their inner desires, highlighting the absence of eternal life and wealth, only showing how to defeat Voldemort.

sentences.text: 哈利，你知不知道，世上没有几个巫师能看到你在镜中看到的东西？
sentences.translation: Harry, do you know how few wizards in the world can see what you see in the mirror?
sentences.explanation: The structure '知不知道' is a way to ask a question in Chinese by combining 'know' and 'not know'. The phrase '世上' means 'in the world', emphasizing the rarity of the ability mentioned in the sentence.

sentences.text: 伏地魔那时就该知道他要对付的是什么，可惜他没有！
sentences.translation: Voldemort should have known what he was dealing with at that time, but unfortunately he did not!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the time element at the beginning, followed by the subject and verb. The use of '该' emphasizes the idea of 'should'.

content.raw_text: “但他现在知道了。你侵入了伏地魔的思想而不受损害，他想附在你身上时却不能不忍受剧烈的痛苦，他在部里已经发现了这一点。但我想他不了解这是为什么，哈利。他那样忙于破坏自己的灵魂，从来无暇去了解一个纯洁健全的灵魂拥有何等无与伦比的力量。”

sentences.text: “但他现在知道了。
sentences.translation: But he knows now.
sentences.explanation: The structure '现在知道了' indicates that the action of knowing has been completed at the present moment.

sentences.text: 你侵入了伏地魔的思想而不受损害，他想附在你身上时却不能不忍受剧烈的痛苦，他在部里已经发现了这一点。
sentences.translation: You invaded Voldemort's mind without being harmed, but he cannot help but endure intense pain when he tries to attach himself to you. He has already discovered this in the Department.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the ability of the protagonist to invade Voldemort's mind without harm, but Voldemort experiences intense pain when trying to attach himself to the protagonist. The last part mentions that Voldemort has already discovered this fact within the Department.

sentences.text: 但我想他不了解这是为什么，哈利。
sentences.translation: But I think he doesn't understand why, Harry.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The word order is different from English, so pay attention to the placement of each word.

sentences.text: 他那样忙于破坏自己的灵魂，从来无暇去了解一个纯洁健全的灵魂拥有何等无与伦比的力量。
sentences.translation: He was so busy destroying his own soul, never had the time to understand the unparalleled power possessed by a pure and healthy soul.
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the contrast between being busy destroying one's soul and not having the time to understand the extraordinary power of a pure and healthy soul.
The sentence consists of two closing quotation marks, indicating the end of a quote or dialogue.

sentences.text: “可是，先生，”哈利说，竭力不想显得像是在争辩，“说到底还是一样，是不是？
sentences.translation: But, sir,
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with the use of '可是' (but) and '还是' (still), as well as the negation '不想' (trying not to). Pay attention to the word order and the use of '说到底' (in the end) in the sentence.

sentences.text: 我必须设法杀死他，否则——
sentences.translation: I must find a way to kill him, otherwise——
sentences.explanation: The structure '否则' (otherwise) is used to indicate a consequence or alternative action if the main action is not carried out. The em dash '——' is used for emphasis or to indicate a sudden break in thought.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark followed by a period.

sentences.text: “必须？
sentences.translation: Must?
sentences.explanation: The sentence consists of the word '必须' meaning 'must' followed by a question mark, indicating uncertainty or seeking confirmation.

sentences.text: ”邓布利多说道，“你当然必须！
sentences.translation: Dumbledore said, "You must, of course!
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a polite imperative structure, emphasizing the necessity of the action with the use of '必须' (must) and '当然' (of course).

sentences.text: 但不是因为预言！
sentences.translation: But not because of the prophecy!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but pay attention to the use of "但" (but) at the beginning of the sentence to indicate contrast.

sentences.text: 而是因为你自己，你不这样做就不会安心！
sentences.translation: It's because of yourself, you won't be at ease if you don't do this!
sentences.explanation: This sentence emphasizes the importance of taking action for one's peace of mind. The structure '不这样做就不会安心' means 'won't be at ease if you don't do this'.

sentences.text: 我们都知道这一点！
sentences.translation: We all know this!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but the use of "都" (all) emphasizes that everyone knows the fact being referred to.

sentences.text: 请想象一下，如果你从未听过那个预言！
sentences.translation: Please imagine, if you have never heard that prophecy!
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the conditional structure '如果...，' (if...), and the word '一下' is used to soften the imperative tone of '请想象' (please imagine).

sentences.text: 你对伏地魔会有什么想法呢？
sentences.translation: What do you think of Voldemort?
sentences.explanation: The structure '对...有什么想法' means 'think of' or 'opinion about'. The particle '呢' is used to soften the tone of the question.

sentences.translation: Think about it!
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple command asking someone to think about something. The repetition of the word '想' emphasizes the action of thinking.

sentences.translation: Looking at the pacing Dumbledore in front of him, Harry started to ponder.

sentences.text: 他想到了他的母亲，他的父亲和小天狼星，想到了塞德里克，想到了伏地魔的种种罪行。
sentences.translation: He thought of his mother, his father, and Sirius, thought of Cedric, thought of Voldemort's various crimes.
sentences.explanation: This sentence uses repetition of '想到了' (thought of) to list the people and things the character is remembering.

sentences.text: 他的胸中腾起一股烈焰，直烧到喉咙口。
sentences.translation: A fierce flame rose in his chest, burning straight to his throat.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a strong feeling or sensation rising in the character's chest and burning all the way up to his throat.

sentences.translation: I want to get rid of him,

content.raw_text: “你当然会！”邓布利多叫道，“你看，预言并没表示你必须做什么！但预言使伏地魔认定你是他的对手……换句话说，你有权选择自己的道路，有权不理睬那个预言！但伏地魔还是会对它念念不忘，他会继续追杀你……所以确实是必然——”

sentences.text: “你当然会！
sentences.translation: Of course you will!
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple affirmation, expressing confidence that the person being addressed will definitely do something.

sentences.text: ”邓布利多叫道，“你看，预言并没表示你必须做什么！
sentences.translation: Dumbledore shouted, 'Look, the prophecy doesn't mean you have to do anything!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure where the speaker is explaining that the prophecy does not necessarily require the listener to take any specific action. The use of '并' and '没' together indicates 'not necessarily' or 'not have to'.

sentences.text: 但预言使伏地魔认定你是他的对手…
sentences.translation: But the prophecy made Voldemort believe that you are his opponent...
sentences.explanation: The structure '使...认定' means 'make...believe/consider'. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession or relationship between '他' (he) and '对手' (opponent).

The sentence contains an ellipsis mark, which indicates that there is more to the text that is not shown. It is commonly used in writing to omit a portion of the content while still conveying the message.

sentences.text: 换句话说，你有权选择自己的道路，有权不理睬那个预言！
sentences.translation: In other words, you have the right to choose your own path, the right to ignore that prophecy!
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the freedom of choice and the power to ignore external predictions or prophecies.

sentences.text: 但伏地魔还是会对它念念不忘，他会继续追杀你…
sentences.translation: But Voldemort will still not forget it, he will continue to hunt you down...
sentences.explanation: The structure '会对' means 'will (continue) to'. The phrase '念念不忘' is a set phrase meaning 'not forget'.
This sentence contains an ellipsis, which indicates that there is more to come or something has been omitted.

sentences.text: 所以确实是必然——
sentences.translation: So it is indeed inevitable——
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but the use of the em dash at the end adds emphasis to the statement.

content.raw_text: 他终于明白了邓布利多要告诉他的意思，那就是：被拽进角斗场去面对一场殊死搏斗和自己昂首走进去是不同的。也许有人会说这二者之间并无多少不同，但邓布利多知道——我也知道，哈利带着一阵强烈的自豪感想道，我父母也知道——这是世界上全部的不同。

sentences.text: 他终于明白了邓布利多要告诉他的意思，那就是：被拽进角斗场去面对一场殊死搏斗和自己昂首走进去是不同的。
sentences.translation: He finally understood the meaning that Dumbledore wanted to tell him, which is: being dragged into the arena to face a life-and-death struggle is different from walking in with one's head held high.
sentences.explanation: This sentence illustrates the difference between being forced into a difficult situation and willingly facing it with confidence.

sentences.text: 也许有人会说这二者之间并无多少不同，但邓布利多知道—
sentences.translation: Perhaps some people would say that there is not much difference between the two, but Dumbledore knows—
sentences.explanation: The structure '这...之间' means 'between these two'. The use of '之间' emphasizes the relationship between the two things being compared.

sentences.text: 我也知道，哈利带着一阵强烈的自豪感想道我父母也知道——
sentences.translation: I also know, Harry thought with a strong sense of pride, my parents also know—
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles in Chinese, as well as the structure of expressing thoughts in the form of '想道'.

sentences.text: 这是世界上全部的不同。
sentences.translation: This is all the different in the world.
sentences.explanation: The structure '这是...的...' is used to indicate possession or description in Chinese. In this sentence, it means 'this is all the different in the world.'
